tabs.html:
D CORE MPO 12F OM3 LSZH 15M Multi-Mode Fiber Patch Cord – High-Speed 40G/100G/400G Connectivity for Bangladesh


The D CORE MPO 12F OM3 LSZH 15M Multi-Mode Fiber Patch Cord is designed for high-density, high-speed network environments. Featuring 12-fiber MPO connectors and OM3 50/125µm multimode fiber, this 15-meter patch cord supports 40G, 100G, and 400G data transmission, making it ideal for modern data centers, enterprise LAN/WAN, and high-bandwidth backbone networks in Bangladesh.

With a Low Smoke Zero Halogen (LSZH) jacket, it is safe for indoor installations and provides durable, reliable, and efficient fiber connectivity in high-performance environments.

Key Features


  • MPO 12F Connector: High-density fiber interface for fast deployment and space-saving installations.
  • OM3 Multimode Fiber (50/125µm): Supports 40G, 100G, and 400G high-speed networks.
  • 15-Meter Length: Perfect for connecting switches, servers, and patch panels in large racks or data center rows.
  • LSZH Jacket: Low smoke, zero halogen for safe indoor installations.
  • High-Speed Data Transmission: Minimal insertion loss for stable, high-bandwidth performance.
  • Durable and Reliable: Factory-tested for consistent performance in critical networks.
  • Wide Compatibility: Works with MPO-enabled switches, SFP/SFP+ modules, high-density enclosures, and optical distribution frames.
